name: fireworks
summary: Successfully completed the Fireworks AI quickstart end-to-end. I installed the OpenAI Python SDK, created a script following the quickstart's Python (OpenAI SDK) example, and obtained a chat completion response from a Fireworks-hosted model. The API returned "Hola." for the prompt "Say hello in Spanish".
deviations: The quickstart documentation specifies model "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v3p1", which returned a 404 NOT_FOUND error. I had to query the /v1/models endpoint to discover available models and substituted "accounts/fireworks/models/deepseek-v4-pro-0813" instead. This is the only deviation from the documented instructions.
